title: 藏经阁残简 第七章 顶层古卷高阶文脉藏经阁残简 第八章 破妄显真旧案藏黑
slug: 残简道藏我靠修复古籍证道
content_zh:
夜色褪去，天光破晓。
青云仙宗晨雾缭绕，山风清浅，吹散了昨夜的阴翳。
藏书阁顶层阁楼，是整座西阁最偏僻、最荒芜之地。
不同于下层堆放普通废简的杂役区域，这里封存的是宗门近百年来损毁的中高阶古籍。
或是修行战册残缺，或是丹经阵图断裂，或是高阶文道心法字迹湮灭。
因其破损太过严重、修复无望，宗门无力修补，便尽数封存在顶层阁楼，常年落锁封禁，积灰百年，无人问津。
刘松昨夜一纸责罚，看似是刻意刁难，让沈砚吃苦受累、清扫废卷。
实则，是亲手将一座深埋尘埃的顶级宝库，送到了沈砚手中。
天光初亮，沈砚独身登临阁楼阶梯。
木质阶梯年久失修，踩上去微微轻响，两侧墙壁布满斑驳痕迹，空气里弥漫着厚重的积灰与陈旧书香。
越往高处，文道残留的气韵便愈发厚重悠远。
旁人感知不到的微弱道韵，在沈砚眼底清晰浮现。
细碎的金色微光，从阁楼门缝之中丝丝缕缕溢出，昭示着内里蕴藏的无尽机缘。
“果然是高阶残卷聚集地。”
沈砚眸光微亮，心底了然。
下层废简只是基础粗浅道书，修复只能稳固根基、滋补灵气。
而顶层封存的，皆是真正失传的中高阶文脉，价值天差地别。
推开尘封的木门。
吱呀——
老旧木门开合，扬起漫天浮灰。

偌大阁楼空旷冷清，一排排老旧木架顶天而立，架上堆叠着厚厚的残破玉简、断裂的兽皮古卷、朽烂的高阶帛书。
层层叠叠，蒙着寸厚灰尘，被时光尘封百年。
一眼望去，满目荒芜。
可落在沈砚眼中，却是遍地黄金，万道源流。
【残简道藏】神魂烙印轻轻震颤，发自本能的渴求、共鸣。
沈砚缓步走入阁楼，随手拂去身前一具残破玉册上的厚灰。
玉册通体暗沉，边缘崩裂大半，内里道纹残缺过半，灵气早已散尽，是宗门判定彻底报废的中阶修行法典。
若是寻常修士观摩，只能看到残缺不全、杂乱无章的零碎道纹，毫无修行价值。
沈砚指尖轻贴玉面。
嗡——
低沉厚重的道鸣悄然在神魂间响起。
金色道文如水流淌，顺着玉册裂痕快速蔓延，填补缺损、重塑道纹、规整法理。
content_en:
The night fades and dawn breaks.
The morning mist shrouded Qingyun Immortal Sect, and the mountain breeze was clear and light, blowing away the gloom of last night.
The attic on the top floor of the Library Pavilion is the most remote and deserted place in the entire West Pavilion.
Different from the handyman area where ordinary scraps are piled on the lower level, what is sealed here is the middle- and high-level ancient books that have been damaged by the sect in the past hundred years.
Either the training record is incomplete, or the Alchemy Sutra array diagram is broken, or the handwriting of high-level literary and spiritual methods is annihilated.
Because the damage was too serious and there was no hope of repair, the sect was unable to repair it, so they sealed them all in the top attic. They were locked and sealed all year round, gathering dust for hundreds of years, and no one cared about them.
Liu Song's punishment last night seemed to be a deliberate attempt to make things difficult, making Shen Yan suffer and clear up the waste papers.
In fact, he personally delivered a top-notch treasure house buried deep in dust to Shen Yan's hands.
At first light, Shen Yan climbed the stairs of the attic alone.
The wooden steps were in disrepair and made a slight sound when stepped on. The walls on both sides were covered with mottled marks. The air was filled with thick dust and the smell of old books.
The higher you go, the more profound and far-reaching the remaining charm of literature and art becomes.
The faint Taoist rhyme that others could not detect clearly emerged in Shen Yan's eyes.
Fragments of golden shimmer spilled out from the cracks in the attic door, revealing the endless opportunities contained within.
"It is indeed a gathering place for high-level scraps."
Shen Yan's eyes brightened slightly, and he understood in his heart.
The scrapped bamboo slips at the lower level are only basic Taoist texts, and repairing them can only stabilize the foundation and nourish the spiritual energy.
What is sealed at the top level are truly lost mid- to high-level cultural contexts, and their values ​​vary greatly.
Push open the dusty wooden door.
Squeak——
The old wooden doors opened and closed, sending up dust all over the sky.
The large attic was empty and deserted, with rows of old wooden shelves standing against the sky. On the shelves were stacked thick piles of broken jade slips, broken animal skin scrolls, and decayed high-grade silk books.
Layers upon layers, covered with thick dust, sealed by time for hundreds of years.
At a glance, everything is desolate.
But in Shen Yan's eyes, there was gold all over the place and thousands of sources.
[Remnant Jian Daozang] The soul brand trembles slightly, coming from instinctive desire and resonance.
Shen Yan walked slowly into the attic and brushed away the thick dust on a broken jade book in front of him.
The entire body of the jade book is dark, with most of its edges cracked, and more than half of the Taoist patterns inside are missing. The spiritual energy has long since dissipated. It is an intermediate-level practice code that the sect has judged to be completely scrapped.
If an ordinary monk observes it, he can only see incomplete and disorganized fragments of Dao patterns, which have no value for practice.
Shen Yan's fingertips lightly touched the jade surface.
Buzz——
The deep and deep sound of Taoism sounded quietly in the soul.
The golden Taoist text flows like water, quickly spreading along the cracks in the jade book, filling the defects, reshaping the Taoist patterns, and regulating the Dharma principles.
